abstract: In this edition of AI Prognosis: These biotech startups don't think drug discovery is where AI can make the biggest difference.

metadata.author: Brittany Trang

content.value:
This is the web edition of STAT’s AI Prognosis newsletter, our guide to artificial intelligence in health care and medicine. Sign up to get it delivered in your inbox every Wednesday. 

“For my 24th birthday, my friends and I spent 3 days in Pennsylvania remaking The Hunger Games from memory,” reads the title card on “The Hunger Games (but better),” a YouTube parody from comedian Grace Reiter, who’s now a “Saturday Night Live” cast member.

I had never heard of this viral video before last week. Maybe it’s because I am of a Certain Generation, but I immediately watched all 42 glorious minutes and am now obsessed.

Continue to STAT+ to read the full story…
